parsed.explanation: The division itself is strongly protective and documented as operating: public-accommodations law covering gender identity since 2008, X markers on licences and birth certificates, hate-crime enhancements, panic-defence repeal, a care shield law, no facility ban, top-tier protective ranking. These are genuine territorial mitigations. But rule 12 holds the visitor to the parent regime for shared axes: visa/passport markers restricted to M/F, X markers discontinued, Feb-2025 cable directing refusal where documents cast 'reasonable doubt' on sex (possible fraud finding), foreign-government travel advisories, federal single-sex facility exclusion, and documented abuse in immigration custody — all unresolved in litigation, so no working remedy is shown. Enforcement of the state's accommodations law against venues, and police/custody/screening practice here, are undocumented. Strong state law over a hostile, partly unremedied national border and federal-facility regime lands at the reduced/elevated boundary.
